summary: Baxter International Inc. filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its credit agreement and providing early tender results and pricing for its previously announced cash tender offers for four series of senior notes (3.132% due 2051, 3.500% due 2046, 4.500% due 2043, 2.539% due 2032). The company increased the aggregate purchase price cap to $600 million from $500 million, excluding accrued interest. No final settlement date will be set. The credit agreement amendment raises the maximum net leverage ratio covenant for five quarters through September 2027 and removes Baxter World Trade SRL as a borrower. The tender offers are part of balance sheet management; watch for final tender acceptance and debt reduction impact.
